title: Northloop Payments On-Demand Payouts Requested by the Seller
content:
An on-demand payout is a payout the seller requests from their own Northloop Payments account to the bank account on file, outside the regular payout schedule.

## Ledger state the payout amount waits on

An on-demand payout is fixed only after the scheduled payout due on the same payout day stands on the payments ledger.

An on-demand payout is not worked out until every chargeback case whose dispute is recorded as won carries its returned-debit entry on the payments ledger.

Before an on-demand payout amount is worked out, every instant payout already sent that day must carry its instant payout fee entry on the payments ledger.

## Situation of use and capability

`request_on_demand_payout_667d53e6` is the seller's request for an on-demand payout from their own Northloop Payments account to the bank account on file, outside the regular payout schedule. One call books one on-demand payout entry on the payments ledger for the amount given, addressed to the bank account currently on file, and lowers the account's total balance by that amount; the seller then sees the on-demand payout and its payout reference in their payout history. The amount is taken exactly as given; nothing else on the account changes.

## How it is invoked

This is the customer's own tool: the support agent unlocks `request_on_demand_payout_667d53e6` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `payout_account_id` | the payments account reference number of the seller's own Northloop Payments account, as read out by the support agent from the payments account lookup | identifier |
| `amount` | the amount of the on-demand payout in USD, as stated by the support agent | a positive number with 2 decimal places (cents); booked exactly as given |

## Return

A text rendering of a dictionary describing the payout booked:

- `status` — the literal `payout_requested` when the payout entry was booked;
- `payout_event_id` — reference of the new payments ledger entry;
- `disbursement_ref` — payout reference of the on-demand payout;
- `payout_method` — the literal `on_demand`;
- `bank_last4` — last four digits of the destination bank account;
- `amount` — the payout amount in USD with 2 decimal places;
- `balance` — the account's total balance in USD after the payout, 2 decimal places;
- `event_date` — the payout date, YYYY-MM-DD.
